desc:
GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Enjoy delicious Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks in Strawberry and Tropical flavors; These snacks are bursting with yummy liquid

FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

ON THE GO: Portable pouches are ideal for the pantry, school lunch box, team snacks, kids parties, and more

CONTAINS: One Value Pack of Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks; 12 Ct, 9.6 oz
features:
Features

Liquid-Filled Center

Each Gusher has a chewy outer shell with a burst of juicy liquid inside, creating a unique and fun snacking experience.

Two Flavors in One Pack

Includes both Strawberry Splash and Tropical flavors to satisfy a range of taste preferences.

Convenient Individual Pouches

Each pouch (0.8 oz) is perfectly portioned for easy snacking on the go, at school, work, or at home.

Gluten-Free and Gelatin-Free

Suitable for people with gluten intolerance or those avoiding animal-based ingredients like gelatin.

Good Source of Vitamin C

Each pouch contains about 10% of the daily recommended value of Vitamin C.

Low Calorie

Each serving contains approximately 80 calories, making it a light snack option.

Benefits

Fun and Kid-Friendly

The "gush" of fruity juice inside each piece adds playfulness, making it exciting for kids and nostalgic for adults.

Easy to Pack & Portion

Pre-wrapped pouches are ideal for lunchboxes, snack drawers, and travel-friendly convenience.

Flavor Variety Keeps It Interesting

With two popular flavors in every pack, it keeps snack time enjoyable and never boring.

Supports Dietary Needs

With no gluten or gelatin, it works well for many dietary lifestyles, including vegetarian.

Vitamin C Boost

Offers a small nutritional advantage over traditional candy by contributing to daily vitamin intake.
ingredients: Tropical Ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Modified Corn Starch, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Palm Oil.
